parsed.name: 光纤光谱仪
parsed.description: 这是一种用于采集光谱信号的光纤光谱仪，可在设定积分时间后测量样品或光源的强度随波长分布。实验室中常用于发射光谱、吸收光谱、荧光光谱及一般光学表征。
parsed.description_en: This is a fiber optic spectrometer used to acquire optical spectra by measuring intensity as a function of wavelength with a configurable integration time. In laboratories it is commonly used for emission, absorption, fluorescence, and general optical characterization.

actions.description: 按指定积分时间采集一次光谱，并保存到文件。
actions.description_en: Acquire a spectrum with the specified integration time and save it to a file.

actions.description: 加载已保存的光谱文件。
actions.description_en: Load a previously saved spectrum file.
